description: Source code for owipcalc, an IP address calculator utility for OpenWrt, implementing CIDR parsing, manipulation, and display functions.

methods.name: cidr_push
methods.description: Push a CIDR object onto the stack.

methods.name: cidr_pop
methods.description: Pop a CIDR object from the stack.

methods.name: cidr_clone
methods.description: Create a copy of a CIDR object.

methods.name: cidr_parse4
methods.description: Parse IPv4 CIDR notation into a CIDR object.

methods.name: cidr_add4
methods.description: Add two IPv4 CIDR addresses.

methods.name: cidr_sub4
methods.description: Subtract one IPv4 CIDR address from another.

methods.name: cidr_network4
methods.description: Convert IPv4 address to network address.

methods.name: cidr_broadcast4
methods.description: Calculate broadcast address for IPv4 CIDR.

methods.name: cidr_contains4
methods.description: Check if one IPv4 CIDR contains another.

methods.name: cidr_netmask4
methods.description: Calculate netmask for IPv4 CIDR.

methods.name: cidr_private4
methods.description: Check if IPv4 address is in private range.

methods.name: cidr_linklocal4
methods.description: Check if IPv4 address is link-local.

methods.name: cidr_prev4
methods.description: Get previous IPv4 address of a CIDR.

methods.name: cidr_next4
methods.description: Get next IPv4 address of a CIDR.

methods.name: cidr_6to4
methods.description: Convert IPv4 CIDR to 6to4 IPv6 prefix.

methods.name: cidr_print4
methods.description: Print IPv4 CIDR address.

methods.name: cidr_parse6
methods.description: Parse IPv6 CIDR notation into a CIDR object.

methods.name: cidr_add6
methods.description: Add two IPv6 CIDR addresses.

methods.name: cidr_sub6
methods.description: Subtract one IPv6 CIDR address from another.

methods.name: cidr_network6
methods.description: Convert IPv6 address to network address.

methods.name: cidr_broadcast6
methods.description: Calculate broadcast address for IPv6 CIDR.

methods.name: cidr_contains6
methods.description: Check if one IPv6 CIDR contains another.

methods.name: cidr_linklocal6
methods.description: Check if IPv6 address is link-local.

methods.name: cidr_ula6
methods.description: Check if IPv6 address is ULA.

methods.name: cidr_print6
methods.description: Print IPv6 CIDR address.

methods.name: cidr_parse
methods.description: Parse CIDR notation (IPv4 or IPv6) into CIDR object.

methods.name: cidr_howmany
methods.description: Calculate number of prefixes fitting into CIDR.

methods.name: cidr_prefix
methods.description: Set prefix length of CIDR.

methods.name: cidr_quiet
methods.description: Suppress output.

methods.name: runop
methods.description: Execute a specified operation on CIDR stack.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments and execute CIDR operations.
